title: Joshua Baker: an engineer's homepage that leads with years and outcomes
note: A software engineer's site. Two sentences in about 28px: '20+ years of software engineering, design, and execution.' in ink, then a grey sentence on who he works with and what he delivers. Under it, a row of six still thumbnails that overlap slightly and shift on hover. Further down: client logos in a grid and one quote. Cream background (#fdfaf6), lots of empty space. Worth reusing: proof that an engineer's home can open with experience in plain words. On its own it is close to generic, so it needs a stronger visual idea.
